summary: XTL Biopharmaceuticals filed a 6-K disclosing a shareholder motion in Tel Aviv court seeking authorization for a derivative claim against its controlling shareholder and directors over the 2024 acquisition of The Social Proxy Ltd., which is in liquidation. Allegations include breached duties and financial irregularities, with damages estimated at NIS 100 million. The company calls the motion meritless. This is litigation disclosure, not a special-situation transaction, so no deal terms apply. Watch court authorization and defense costs.
